title: Freeze canonical supervisor contracts or issue non-promotion

scope.assurance_scope: PCPR Python v1 Phase-0 canonical supervisor-contract freeze or honest non-promotion only
scope.implementation_delta: Add CanonicalSupervisorContractFreeze@1 to freeze the public objective, task, event, ContextPack, state-machine, and receipt contracts only after live PCPR-001 supervisor_promoted qualification, measured normative surface identities, and a live competing-authority prohibition. Current-head PCPR-001 is rnd_non_promoted with unavailable live cohort and efficiency targets, so this evaluator issues rnd_non_promoted / supervisor_non_promoted and does not freeze. Placeholder schemas, hermetic or simulated qualification, operator override, and an unavailable PCPR-003 inventory cannot mint a freeze. The evaluator never writes DuckDB or Quack state and never emits a closed PCPR release outcome. Shared-contract stabilization remains PCPR-040.

DuckDB task state was not queried and remains typed unavailable. Quack was not contacted. This worker did not write DuckDB or Quack state.
